issues.description: Method signature mismatch for Pneumatic.openValve: the UML/problem statement defines openValve(): void (no parameters), but the solution interface declares openValve(int duration). A student implementing according to the UML will produce an interface/implementation that does not match the reference solution and will fail compatibility with any tests expecting the solution signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the artifacts consistent by either (a) changing the solution interface to `void openValve()` and updating all implementers accordingly, or (b) updating the UML/problem statement to specify `openValve(duration: int): void` if the parameter is intended.
